LanguageData.SL_RaidOriginLeaderInfo: Base Leader {0} decided to join this raid, if you can capture or kill them - all future raids from this base will be weakened.
LanguageData.SL_SiteOwnershipInfo: Base {0} has claimed ownership of this site.
LanguageData.SL_JumpToBaseDesc: Jump to the base that owns this site.
LanguageData.SL_ActingLeaderChosen: The acting {LEADERTITLE} is {PAWN_nameDef} until a new leader is chosen.
LanguageData.SL_PowerVoidEndedLetterLabel: {FACTION_name} has come out of a Power Void.
LanguageData.SL_NewLeaderElectedLetterBody: {PAWN_nameDef} has been selected as the new faction leader.
LanguageData.SL_RiotingSuccess: Rioting at {0} succeeded. {PAWN_nameDef} is the new leader.
LanguageData.SL_RiotingFailed: Rioting at {0} has failed. The current leader remains in power.
LanguageData.SL_PrisonersDetected: High value prisoners detected in the area.
LanguageData.SL_ReinforcementsCalledBody: {0} has called for reinforcements. They will arrive in {1}.
LanguageData.SL_SanctionedCannotTrade: Cannot trade with this faction. They are sanctioned.
LanguageData.SL_EnableAlerts.Desc: If Disabled, you will not receive notifications of base/faction events.
LanguageData.SL_EnableEvents.Desc: If Disabled, base/faction events will no longer generate.
LanguageData.SL_DistanceWeight.Desc: Controls how strongly a faction's proximity to your colony influences its chance of performing raids. At 0%, distance does not matter.
LanguageData.SL_BasesPerLeader.Desc: How many bases a single leader oversees. Set to 1 for every base to have a unique leader.
LanguageData.SL_BlacklistDesc: Factions on this list will not have base leaders generated for them.
LanguageData.SL_KidnappedColonistsDetected: Kidnapped colonists detected in the area
LanguageData.SL_DoctrinesSubheader: Doctrine bonuses or stat modifiers are applied at all times. Eliminating leaders can result in doctrines being removed.
LanguageData.SL_NoDoctrines: This faction currently has no doctrines in use
LanguageData.SL_UnknownProposerDesc: The identity of the person proposed this doctrine is unknown.
LanguageData.SL_InvestigateNotice: Investigating will take {0} days. You can only investigate one doctrine at a time.
LanguageData.SL_InvestigationInProgressWarning: You are currently investigating this doctrine. Progress will not be saved upon cancellation.
LanguageData.SL_InvestigationCompletedDesc: Investigation concluded! {2} proposed the {0} doctrine for {1}.
LanguageData.SL_LeaderDoctrinesLost: Leader {0} Doctrines are no longer applying to {1}: {2}
LanguageData.SL_AbsoluteBordersCannotTrade: Cannot trade with this faction. Their borders are closed due to recent hostilities.
LanguageData.SL_HitAndRunRegrouping: {0} forces are retreating to regroup for another assault!
LanguageData.SL_ScorchedEarthTriggered: {0} defenders are destroying valuable facilities as they abandon the base!
LanguageData.SL_InterventionRaidLetterBody: {0} has dispatched a raid to eliminate the visiting {1} caravan!
LanguageData.SL_MutualDefenseLetterBody: {0} has declared a retaliation raid following your aggression against their allies, {1}!
LanguageData.SL_HitAndRunRegroupPointMultiplier: Hit and Run regroup threat factor
LanguageData.SL_MaxDoctrinesPerFaction.Desc: Maximum number of doctrines randomly assigned to a faction when its leadership is first generated.
LanguageData.SL_InvestigationDurationDays.Desc: How many days an investigation takes before the origin of a doctrine is revealed.
LanguageData.SL_AbsoluteBordersCooldownDays.Desc: How long factions with the Absolute Borders doctrine will refuse trade after you raid one of their settlements.
LanguageData.SL_LeaderLegacyDurationMultiplier.Desc: Duration of power events against factions with the Leader's Legacy doctrine is multiplied by this factor.
LanguageData.SL_InterventionRaidChance.Desc: Chance that a hostile faction with the Intervention doctrine dispatches a raid against a visiting enemy caravan.
LanguageData.SL_InterventionRaidDelayHours.Desc: How long the intervention raid takes to arrive after being dispatched.
LanguageData.SL_MutualDefenseChance.Desc: Chance that a faction with the Mutual Defense doctrine declares a retaliation raid when an ally's settlement is attacked.
LanguageData.SL_MutualDefenseDelayHours.Desc: How long the retaliation raid takes to arrive after being declared.
LanguageData.SL_ForcesPreservationMultiplier.Desc: Multiplier applied to the casualty threshold before raiders with the Forces Preservation doctrine retreat.
LanguageData.SL_HitAndRunCasualtyThreshold.Desc: Fraction of pawns lost before raiders with the Hit and Run doctrine break off and retreat to regroup.
LanguageData.SL_HitAndRunRegroupPointMultiplier.Desc: Threat points multiplier for the regrouped follow-up raid.
LanguageData.SL_HitAndRunRegroupDelayHours.Desc: How long the regrouped raid takes to return to the assault.
LanguageData.SL_HitAndRunLockoutDays.Desc: Minimum time between consecutive Hit and Run regroup raids.
LanguageData.SL_AttritionSiegeChance.Desc: Chance that raids from factions with the Attrition Warfare doctrine arrive as sieges.
LanguageData.SL_NoMercyExecutionRange.Desc: Search radius in which raiders with the No Mercy doctrine hunt for downed colonists to execute.
LanguageData.SL_ScorchedEarthMaxFires.Desc: Maximum number of structures set alight when a base under the Scorched Earth doctrine is abandoned.
LanguageData.SL_GraciousRepatriationMultiplier.Desc: Bonus goodwill gained, as a fraction of the original gain, when returning healthy prisoners to a faction with the Gracious Repatriation doctrine.
LanguageData.SL_FallenVenerationCorpseGoodwill.Desc: Goodwill gained per corpse of a fallen faction member returned to a faction with the Fallen Veneration doctrine.
